## Bihar Board Matric Result 2026
Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) dwara Class 10th (Matric) Annual Examination 2026 ka result officially declare kar diya gaya hai. Students apna Roll Code aur Roll Number enter karke marksheet download kar sakte hain.
